    Transport of ray bases #

    Corollary 5.5 (mesh-deformations.tex): the isomorphism A ≅ A₀ "preserves endpoint actions and the subspaces M(f,h) of Definition 3.4, and therefore identifies ray A with P". Here: an algebra isomorphism matching the chosen primitive idempotents carries corners, corner radicals, corner units, rays and the spaces M(f,h) (ray_fwd, insertionSpan_fwd), hence ray bases (hasRayBasis_of_algEquiv).

    The rays are defined relative to a complete set of primitive idempotents. In a basic algebra any two complete sets are conjugate (exists_algEquiv_idempotents), so a ray basis for one set gives one for any other.
